title: Cobblemon: Sphere Control
description: Let you tune the catch rate multiplier for balls
body:
A simple Addon for the cobblemon Mod, that will let you change the catch rate multiplier of  the various pokeballs, and even a little setting to let the ancient balls break on hit with a chance. 

All the configuration happen in the config file, if you need more help hit me up on my discord!

Mod icon is temporary, if someone wanna hit me up to make one im open to pay for it.

_Project made with the help of IA._
